records.locator: Chapter XXVI, table 1 (592), printed page 722, lines 99733-99832
records.definition: State-owned enterprises included in the ownership-transformation process from 1 August 1990 through 31 December 2008.
limitations: This is not a count of completed sales.
This is not a count of foreign acquisitions.
The table combines several distinct legal and institutional routes.

records.locator: Chapter XXVI, table 3 (594), printed page 723, lines 99974-100054
records.definition: State-owned enterprises privatized by the direct method.
limitations: Direct privatization includes several routes; it is not synonymous with sale to a foreign investor.

records.locator: Chapter XXVI, table 3 (594), printed page 723, lines 99993-99999
records.definition: Direct privatizations conducted by paid lease of assets.
limitations: A lease is not equivalent to an immediate transfer of legal ownership.

records.locator: Chapter XXVI, table 4 (595), printed page 724, lines 100057-100081
records.definition: Employee companies among companies established on assets of directly privatized and liquidated state-owned enterprises.
limitations: This is a subset of the 1,825 companies in the table, not all employee buyouts in Poland.

records.locator: Chapter XXVI, table 4 (595), printed page 724, lines 100076-100105
records.definition: Companies with foreign-capital participation among 265 companies with State Treasury participation established on assets of directly privatized and liquidated SOEs.
limitations: This is not the total number of foreign acquisitions in Poland.
It is a narrowly defined subset and must not be generalized to all privatizations or foreign-owned companies.

records.locator: Chapter XXVI, table 2 (593), printed page 722-723, lines 99833-99970
records.definition: Commercialized companies participating in the National Investment Fund programme.
limitations: Programme participation is not equivalent to a single direct foreign acquisition.
